notes.title: Bugs fixing
notes.notes: Hello everyone! I've made some minor bug fixes to the ship sprite animation and the text on the game's ending screen. If you spot any other bugs, please let me know.

notes.title: ASTRONAVE IS LIVE!
notes.notes: Greetings, guys! In my spare time, I've been delving into the craft of solo  development, particularly enjoying the creation of compact arcade games with straightforward mechanics, inspired by Kenta Cho's legacy and others minimalists. "ASTRONAVE" is my first project—a bite-sized arcade experience designed for replayability, centered around the simple thrill of surpassing your own high score, with mecanics based on classic tube shooters like "Gyruss" and "Tempest". I value your feedback immensely and am committed to providing ongoing support for my creations. Hope you enjoy it!
